text: 1. Applicants should be non-Chinese citizens in good physical and mental health.2. Applicants for doctoral programs must have a master's degree and be under the age of 40, applicants for master's programs must have a bachelor degree and be under the age of 35.3.Applicants should have good conduct, without any record of violation of school rules and regulations, nor any record of public security punishment or criminal record.4. Applicants should have excellent grades and clear purpose of studying in China, with a GPA of 3.0 or above in the previous academic year without failing or repeated subjects.5. Chinese Medium Program: Applicants must reach a score above 180 in HSK 5 or provide other comparable certificates proving Chinese proficiency.English Medium Program: Applicants from non-English-speaking countries must reach a score of 6.5 in IELTS (6.0 or above for each item) or above 90 in TOEFL (20 or above for each item) ; or provide other comparable certificates proving English proficiency. Applicants from English-speaking countries or receiving the last degree with the instruction in English are exempt from submitting the English proficiency certificates, but the certificate of English medium issued by the school graduated from shall be provided.
